executive_summary: Maven build failed with 22 compilation errors. The primary issue is that a custom Column class conflicts with JPA's @Column annotation, causing type conversion errors across entity classes. Additionally, there are method signature mismatches and missing setter methods.

errors.message: incompatible types: Column cannot be converted to java.lang.annotation.Annotation (19 occurrences across Column.java, Task.java, User.java)
errors.root_cause: Custom Column class name conflicts with JPA @Column annotation. The compiler is confusing the custom entity class with the javax.persistence.Column annotation, causing type conversion errors in all entity classes that use @Column annotations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Rename the custom Column.java entity class to a non-conflicting name such as BoardColumn.java or ColumnEntity.java. Update all references in Task.java, User.java, and related service/repository classes to use the new class name.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types; required: Long,Pageable found: Long,int,int,String
errors.root_cause: TaskController is calling getUserTasks with 4 parameters (Long, int, int, String) but TaskService interface defines it with 2 parameters (Long, Pageable). The controller is passing pagination parameters individually instead of using Spring's Pageable object.
errors.fix_recommendation: In TaskController.java line 46, create a Pageable object using PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(sortBy)) and pass it to getUserTasks(userId, pageable) instead of passing individual pagination parameters.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method setLastUpdated(LocalDateTime) (2 occurrences at lines 41 and 56)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryColumnDataStore is calling setLastUpdated() method on Column entity, but this setter method does not exist in the Column class definition.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add the setLastUpdated(LocalDateTime lastUpdated) setter method to the Column entity class, or if using Lombok, ensure @Setter annotation is present on the lastUpdated field.
